title: harshuljain13/llm-inference-at-scale maps the production serving stack
friendlyTitle: A practical guide to serving AI models at scale
summary: llm-inference-at-scale is a practitioner-oriented handbook for serving language models in production, with about 240 GitHub stars at publication. The repository organizes explanatory notebooks and guidance around the systems decisions involved in moving from a model to a scalable inference service.
friendlySummary: This repository explains the systems needed to run language models for many users. It collects practical lessons and notebooks about production inference.
whyItMatters: Engineers can use it as a structured learning and reference resource when comparing serving architectures, performance techniques and operational trade-offs. It is educational material rather than a ready-made deployment, so examples should be validated against the team’s models, hardware and reliability requirements.
friendlyWhyItMatters: It can help engineers understand the choices before building or buying a model-serving system. Test every example with your own model and hardware before using it in production.
